name: opencode-sessions-transfer
description: Session directory transfer and relocation plugin for opencode (hexagonal architecture)

scripts.build: bun build src/main/tui-entry.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[dir]/sessions-transfer.tui.[ext]" --target bun && bun build src/main/plugin-entry.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[dir]/sessions-transfer.[ext]" --target bun && bun run build:v2
scripts.build:v2: bun build src/main/v2-server-entry.ts --outfile dist/v2/server.js --target bun && bun build src/main/v2-tui-entry.ts --outfile dist/v2/tui.js --target bun
scripts.test: bun test --max-concurrency=1 test/unit test/component test/e2e test/arch
scripts.coverage: bun test --max-concurrency=1 --coverage test/unit test/component test/e2e test/arch
scripts.install:plugin:v1: bun run build && bun scripts/install-plugin.mjs v1
scripts.install:plugin:v2: bun run build && bun scripts/install-plugin.mjs v2
